scope: Six preselected existing seed-0 HUG poses, actual compiled visible-object triangle query family; current original targets only. Cube has a separate prior query family and is not silently pooled. No new inference, optimizer, physics, episode, task label or training.
eligibility: Primary paired diagnostics require query outside closed native hand and every actual target collider, both unsigned distances above 10 nm and inside the band, same nearest anatomical proxy label, unique normal and nearest point/label under declared numerical tie tolerances, no buried target nearest point. Closest-point membership in actual visual object is split into outside/inside/boundary strata. Strict orientation-sign witnesses additionally require both closest points outside visual object and dot values outside numerical deadzone. Different labels, inside query, lost/new and normal-unavailable regions are retained separately.
normal_definition: Native whole MANO facet normal, flipped globally if signed volume negative. Actual visual triangle normals similarly outward global orientation, closed consistently oriented topology hash-bound. Target mesh convex-hull outward facet normals; exact analytic primitive geom_query SDF normal, excluding rim/edge/corner/center or competing nearest-face degeneracy from primary diagnostics. Object-facing compatibility = -dot(hand_normal, object_normal), positive facing and negative away. No contact-force interpretation.
matching: Same original visual object-side centroid sites and area weights; native labels fixed skinning-majority proxy. Native triangle candidates within 10 nm of min: competing labels, normals >1e-6 vector norm, or closest points >10 nm invalidate. Target pergeom candidates use same distance rule; competing geom labels/normals/points and competing facets or analytic edge/corner exclude. Coplanar same-label same-point multiple triangle ties retain their unique normal. Exclusion categories overlap and union denominator reported.
shared_sampling_fields: Sibling frozen sampling audit exact fullfinite current distances, closest points, normals and geom IDs are ephemeral inputs hash-bound to original query cache and original targets; own orientation audit regresses native allpart distances and current previous <=5mm distances/occupancy. No raw arrays published.
numerical_tolerances: 10 nm tie/query boundary and 0.1 micrometer visual sign boundary are diagnostic floating-point safeguards, not scientific mapping acceptance margins. Dot deadzone1e-6 suppresses numerical sign claims near orthogonality; it is not a normal accuracy proof.
metric_limitations: Centroid geometric normal distributions and sign witnesses do not bound unsampled normals. Normal fields are piecewise discontinuous; distance Lipschitz bounds cannot become angular error bounds.
Compatibility compares geometric normals against the source visual mesh, not normal forces or measured contact.
Closest hand points inside visual object retained separately; positive compatibility on retained region does not certify lost/new regions.
Individual collider distance can select buried surface; target buried candidates are separately excluded, and no global externally accessible boundary proof is supplied.

Whole native surface closed and source object topology closed oriented, but exhaustive selfintersection checks unavailable. Absolute winding inside is conditional on this topology; no exact intersection volume.
Actual target collider geometry differs from MANO anatomical surface and source visual object; no tissues or physical transfer certificate.
Native/mapped independent perpart areas may overlap; anatomical labels are proxies.
Area weights are centroid quadrature estimates; repeated-density changes are observed sensitivity, not standard errors or confidence intervals.
These six development cases use one MANO shape and do not establish independent unseen-object validation.
Query family excludes cube; prior cube surface measurements remain separate.
